description: Create a new custom object schema. Define fields, searchable fields, primary display field, and icon.

description.description: Human-readable description of the custom object

fields.description: Array of field definition objects for the schema

icon.description: Icon identifier for the custom object

key.description: Unique key for the schema (lowercase, no spaces)

labels.description: Label configuration object with singular and plural display names

primaryDisplayField.description: Field key used as the primary display value for records

searchableFields.description: Array of field keys that should be searchable

name: crm_create_object_schema
